arch: workspace crates by boundary - one responsibility per crate
lib plus thin bin split - logic testable without main
error enums - callers match, not parse strings
tasks with shutdown token - no orphaned work
description: Write safe Rust with ownership discipline, Result handling, and clippy-clean code. Use for any Rust code or review.
idioms: question-mark operator for propagation, combinators over pyramids
borrow over clone; clone only at proven boundaries
newtype pattern for units and ids
traits for behavior, structs for data
builder for structs with many options
name: rust-code
pitfalls: unwrap in prod paths - return Result
cloning large data in loops - borrow or restructure
blocking calls inside async - use spawn_blocking
over-generic lifetimes - elide first, annotate later
style: cargo fmt plus clippy deny-warnings in CI
no unwrap or expect outside tests
docs on public API with compiling examples
small modules, re-export a clean facade
testing: unit tests in-module, integration in tests/, doc-tests as examples.
triggers: setting up Cargo workspaces, clippy, or tests
